Before play

PREP

A caffeine-free pre-game gummy for the first set. Eat one courtside, 20-30 minutes before play. No shaker, no water, nothing designed to argue with sleep after an evening match.

Use
1 ball before play
Feel
Arrive ready, not wired
Formula note
B vitamins and magnesium, with no hidden stimulant blend
During play

RALLY

Electrolytes for stop-start racquet sport. Drop one ball in your court bottle, let it dissolve clear, and drink between games. Water still looks like water; the minerals are doing the work.

Use
1 ball per 500-1000 ml
Feel
Clean hydration without sugar
Formula note
Sodium and potassium, plus magnesium and calcium
After play

RESET

Tomorrow's match starts tonight. Drop one ball in cold water within 30 minutes after play, while you change, eat, and come back down from the court.

Use
1 ball after play
Feel
A real recovery ritual
Formula note
Essential amino acids, tart cherry, vitamin C, magnesium

Why this copy is cleaner

No magic. No stimulant theater. No fake reviews.

Tennis and padel players already understand the problem: the first set is slow, the third set gets expensive, and evening matches can ruin sleep. The page sells a routine around those moments while staying inside the safer language for supplements.

Questions

Clear before checkout.

Is this a Shopify store or a separate platform?

The cleanest first version is Shopify for checkout, subscriptions, inventory, tax, and payments, plus a subscription app or custom portal for skip, pause, swap, and frequency controls.

Why is the first order more expensive?

It includes the permanent experience: bottle, home docks, and packaging. Later orders are refills, so the recurring price is lower.

How many matches does one refill cover?

A three-tube refill covers ten full match days if you use PREP, RALLY, and RESET every time. You can stretch it longer by using only the product moments you need.

Does PREP contain caffeine?

No. PREP is built for evening racquet sport: zero caffeine, zero guarana, zero hidden energy blend.
